notes.title: Version 1.3.1 changelog
notes.notes:
[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Cyrillic alphabet support.
[*] Added Russian translation.
[*] Added Italian translation.
[*] Added Community button to the main menu.
[/list]
[b]General:[/b]

notes.title: Version 1.3.0b changelog
notes.notes:
[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added D-Pad keybinding for moving.
[/list]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause a hardlock if the killer caught Adam while a collected item was on the screen.
[*]Refresh achievement progress every time a new game is started. This is to prevent getting achievements by doing them partially and restarting.
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween update
notes.notes:
Get ready for some treat hunting!

Play The Night of the Scissors from October 25th to October 31st to find all the treats and get a special seasonal achievement. Keep in mind that if you miss the event, you will have to wait until next year Halloween season to get the achievement!

Good luck returning to the Snipper's hideout!

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Halloween event during the spooky week.
[*] Added seasonal killer Halloween custome.
[*] Added seasonal collectable Halloween treats.
[*] Added seasonal Halloween achievement.
[/list]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added missing Spanish translation.
[/list]

notes.title: Multi-language update
notes.notes:
We're proud to present you the patch 1.2.0 for The Night of the Scissors, which includes one of the most demanded features, language localization.

[b]List of official translations:[/b]
[list]
[*]Spanish
[*]Portuguese
[*]German
[*]French
[*]Finnish
[/list]
[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added localization support
[*] Added auto detect language feature (if language is available, based on your system language)
[*] Added language selector to the settings screen
[*] Added custom localization support
[/list]
[h3]Non official translations/Custom localization[/h3]
One thing to point out, is that there's also support for non-official translations, if your language isn't available for the game, you can [b]be the first to add the translation[/b]!

Under the "<installation folder>/The Night of the Scissors_Data/StreamingAssets/Translations" directory you will find easy to follow instructions in order to add your own custom translation by editing a file.

[h3]Community[/h3]
One minor thing I'd like to share is the creation of a [url=https://discord.com/invite/nqVQkw5]Discord server[/url] for The Night of the Scissors and every game published by [i]selewi[/i]. Join us and say hello!
